scratch/design.md item 16 is accepted: training_job requires name=, an eval job is named by its tournament, and the loader stops naming a sole unnamed job for the file stem (refuse with an error saying to pass name=). Reason: run addresses decide "already run", so they must not change when a job is added beside another. Check what this means for the compact EXPERIMENT@SEED address form and for runs already stored at it.
